properties.value: Dependency inventory: the build ships the secp256k1 ECDSA library (Shor-vulnerable signature primitive) in every member project that uses the web3/ethereumjs stack. No direct secp256k1 API call found in application source; presence in the shipped tree is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey (the browserified OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF) ships in the member task7 builds via the web3/browserify stack. No application call site; presence in the shipped tree is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf (bcrypt-derived PBKDF, OpenSSH variant) ships in the member builds as a transitive dependency. No application call site found; the KDF ships whether or not this app invokes it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/poly1305 (the Poly1305 one-time authenticator, used inside @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 AEAD) ships in the task5 frontend and both slide demo builds. No application call site; presence in the shipped tree is the inventory fact. Poly1305 is symmetric MAC — quantum relevance limited (Grover), not Shor-broken.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Student todo-list apps: non-cryptographic PRNG used solely for client-side UI list IDs / display strings, not for tokens, secrets or key material. CWE-338 pattern is present, impact here is low.
